source_projection.fit_population: all 18 original sequence-zero starters per regular-season game
source_projection.zero_pa_rows: retained as truthful support, never deleted or clipped
source_projection.later_season_reader: stop before projecting any 2025 outcome field

historical_2024_input_rule.confirmed_slot_distribution: not scored without prospective receipt evidence

market_definitions.zero_pa_treatment: truthful player-game outcome retained; this is probability-foundation scoring, not sportsbook settlement grading

comparators.league_rate: 2023 league PA distribution plus 2023 league per-PA outcome rates
comparators.player_historical_rate: time-safe 200-PA empirical-Bayes player rate plus frozen legacy two-point PA volume at 4.05 PA
comparators.frozen_production_simulator: required before promotion; unavailable as an identity-aligned 2024 comparator
comparators.valid_market_implied: required where available; no timestamp-certified executable 2024 prices exist

selection_gates.proper_score_materiality: candidate-minus-each available comparator point and paired date-block 95% upper bound must each be below negative 1% of comparator Brier and log loss
selection_gates.discrimination: candidate AUC must be noninferior for each market
selection_gates.calibration: candidate 10-equal-count-bin ECE and calibration-in-the-large absolute error must each be noninferior
selection_gates.high_probability_tail: top candidate-prediction decile fixed before scoring; candidate absolute observed-minus-predicted error must be noninferior
